description: Finds companies across everything we track: newly formed New York, Colorado, Oregon, Connecticut and Pennsylvania businesses with a website found with proof, and every FDIC-insured bank in any state. Filter by state, source, city, name, formation date, technology on their site (for example Shopify or WordPress), whether they publish a phone, role inbox or contact page, and hiring. Returns register details, website, technologies and job board, newest first. No match is never charged.

city.description: City as the register gives it, not case sensitive.

has.description: Keep companies whose site publishes these: any of phone, role_email, contact_page.

hiring.description: true for companies with open roles on a job board we read, false for none.

offset.description: Skip this many, for the next page.

source.description: Where the company came from: state_register (new businesses) or fdic (banks), comma separated.

state.description: Two-letter US state codes, comma separated.

tech.description: Technology names on the home page, comma separated; all must be present.

name: company_search
title: Search the companies we track
